0022600159.text: The Charlotte Hornets (3-3, 8th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, on a two-game losing streak) host the Detroit Pistons (5-1, 1st in the East and 1st in the Central, on a two-game winning streak) in the Hornets' eighth game of the season. Charlotte is missing Coby White, Grant Williams, Kon Knueppel and Kylan Boswell, while Detroit is without Isaiah Joe and Jalen Duren. The Pistons beat the Hornets 97-89 in Detroit in their only meeting this season, and Charlotte lost all three of its matchups against Detroit in 2025-26.
